title: The adopted credential case probed adoption only for an unissued version, so a provider that confirmed an unknown or revoked credential passed every case
resolution: The adopted credential case confirms the revoked credential's adopted version after the revocation and version 1 of an unknown credential, each expecting not-found; the in-memory SCM gained a defect for each, and both defect tests fail before the suite change.

title: The repository remote case never checked the refusal for a repository the plugin cannot see, so a provider that invents a URL for any repository passed
resolution: The fixture gained hiddenRepository, a repository the plugin's own identity cannot see, and the repository remote case expects not-found for it; a defect that invents a URL for it is reported, and its test fails before the suite change.

title: The Long run scenario refreshed after the expiry yet kept the previous version until adoption, against the requirement and contract section 3 where a version's own expiry always ends it
resolution: The scenario refreshes before the expiry, and the previous version works until the adoption, a revocation, or its own expiry, whichever comes first; scenarios for unknown and revoked adoptions and the hidden repository were added.

title: The refresh expiry test set an expiry one second ahead of the live clock that the suite and the fake check after asynchronous work, so a slow host got extra findings
resolution: The fake takes an injected clock; the test freezes it and sets the expiry half a lifetime ahead, before the original expiry. With Date.now advanced 200 ms per call the old test fails and the new one passes.

title: The fail-before evidence cited mutation scripts and logs only in the session scratchpad, so no reader could trace or repeat it
resolution: The fail-before section now lists each mutant's exact edit and the commands that ran it, and names no file outside the repository.
